label: Metastability and the two-flop synchronizer
subgoals: Explain why a flop sampled during its setup-hold window can go metastable
Insert two destination-clocked flops in series
Accept one cycle of uncertainty in synchronizer latency

label: Structural CDC checks

Stretch or handshake pulses that cross from fast to slow domains

Assert the handshake protocol that keeps a crossing safe
